quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Presents Sotyktu (deucravacitinib) (09-17-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Two-year results of the Phase 3 POETYK PsA-2 study and its open-label extension (presented at CCR-West): in adults with active psoriatic arthritis treated continuously with Sotyktu (deucravacitinib), ACR 20/50/70 response rates at Week 104 were 76.2%, 52.6% and 34.6% (observed) and 65.3%, 44.9% and 29.4% (nonresponder imputation), with MDA response of 51.2% (observed); safety was consistent with the established profile with no new signals (adverse events in 86.6% of 604 patients with any exposure, serious adverse events 12.6%, discontinuations for adverse events 7.6%). POETYK PsA-1 extension results are to be presented at an upcoming medical meeting.
